WITH sma_10005_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __cancelled_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS __net_sales_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS __buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_11.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_11.net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_11.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_18.avg_order_value) AS avg_order_value
  , MAX(subq_18.cancel_rate) AS cancel_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  FROM sma_10005_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
) subq_11
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    case when valid_order_count = 0 then null else net_sales_cents / valid_order_count end AS avg_order_value
    , case when order_count = 0 then null else cancelled_order_count / order_count end AS cancel_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
      , SUM(__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
      , SUM(__cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
      , SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    FROM sma_10005_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
  ) subq_17
) subq_18
